info.title: Satflux for WooCommerce
info.description: The six integration endpoints use a scoped Bearer integration token bound to the current store/company link. OAuth-style connect-code exchange is separate, one-time and valid for ten minutes. Never put production credentials into examples or browsers. Server-side company isolation and issuance entitlements remain authoritative. Monetary unit_price, order_total and total use major units of the declared currency; quantity and tax_rate are numeric (tax percent). Legacy server invoices and encrypted local-first inbox documents have different response shapes. Lists are not paginated here.
